messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up 10 we need a distinct playbook for billing fixes after the Mar 10 delayed ingestion. Not just tickets 	
: automated provisional credits, manual review thresholds, audit tags, and SLAs for customer outreach.
Noah Rivera: Strong +1. Also want an escrowed credit bucket for emergency restores so we can issue immediate provisional credits and reconcile later. Keeps customers happy while ops finish the audit.
Priya Singh: From compliance perspective we need an immutable audit trail for any crediting: who approved, which backfill run id, and a reason code. Prefer ledger tags over freeform notes.
Alex Chen: Agree on ledger tags. I'll extend the journal schema to include: backfill_run_id, incident_id, approver, approval_ts. Example CSV columns for provisional run: invoice_id, customer_id, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd, backfill_run_id, incident_id.
Julie Park: Support asks: a templated comms set for 3 cases: small (<$100), moderate ($100-$5k), and large (>$5k). Large gets a dedicated CSM outreach and apology + expedited reconciliation.
Maria Gomez: Proposed owners: Noah = credits escrow implementation + policy, Alex = journal tagging + CSV pipeline, Priya = compliance signoff, Julie = comms templates, Maria = postmortem and SLA doc. Can everyone ack?
billing-bot: Incident INC-4723: follow-up checklist added  (severity: P2) 	.
Noah Rivera: Ack. I'll prototype an "escrow credits" workflow: admin UI to allocate provisional credits and an automated reversal if backfill shows no delta. Also add a TTL of 30 days.
Priya Singh: Compliance notes: any provisional credit > $1,000 requires 2nd approval from finance lead. Also need exportable audit logs for external audits.
Alex Chen: For automation: run extraction query against snapshot ranges and produce a signed CSV. Sample query: 
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(tokens) as token_delta
FROM token_ledger
WHERE ingest_window_id = 'backfill-2145'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING SUM(tokens) != 0;
```
Alex Chen: I'll sign the CSV with an HMAC and include manifest metadata for the audit pipeline.
Julie Park: Communications timeline: internal notice within 48h of confirmed impact; provisional external notice 72h for affected customers with <$5k exposure; SLA-based outreach within 7 business days for larger accounts.
Maria Gomez: We also need a recurring-incident retro: set up a monthly metering health review and a rapid postmortem cadence after each ingestion incident. Add epic INGEST-GC-HARDEN for long-term fix.
Noah Rivera: Risk log: automated credits could be abused if queries are wrong. Mitigation: require dry-run approval + sign-off and a 2-person review for applying credits > $500.
Priya Singh: I'll draft compliance checklist and a short policy doc for the two-person approval flows and data retention for audit artifacts.
Alex Chen: I'll deliver a prototype CSV generator and journaling script in 4 business days. Noah will deliver escrow UI PR in 6 business days.
Julie Park: I'll produce the three tiers of comms templates in 3 business days and a support playbook for manual expedite requests.
Maria Gomez: I'll assemble the postmortem action table and SLA draft. First pass in 5 business days. We'll reconvene for a 30min sync next Tue 10:00am PT.
All: Acks.
Maria Gomez: One small ask 	: tag all manual journal entries with INCIDENT=INC-4723 and BACKFILL_ID once applied so finance audit can trace entries easily.
billing-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled for Tue 10:00am PT (channel: #finance).
